extraction.name: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: MTEB spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages. Through the benchmarking of 33 models on MTEB, we establish the most comprehensive benchmark of text embeddings to date.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.citeAs: Muennighoff, N., Tazi, N., Magne, L., & Reimers, N. (2023). MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark. arXiv:2210.07316v3.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB incorporates SemEval datasets (STS11 - STS22) and BEIR alongside a variety of other datasets from various tasks. Custom-made datasets for MTEB were created using the public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv, available data from Reddit posts, and available data from StackExchange posts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: SemEval datasets (STS11 - STS22), BEIR, public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv, Reddit posts, StackExchange posts, Amazon customer reviews, online banking queries, English Twitter messages, movie reviews, Amazon Alexa virtual assistant utterances, Civil Comments platform comments, Sprint community questions, AskUbuntu questions, CNN/DailyMail summaries.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For S2S datasets, the input text is simply the title of the paper, while for P2P the input text is the concatenation of the title and the abstract. For ArxivClustering, only the first category is used if multiple are given. Subsets of all labels are selected and articles are sampled from those labels to yield splits with a varying amount and size of clusters.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MTEB imposes no limit on the input length, leaving it up to the models to truncate if necessary. Evaluation is performed on the test splits of all datasets except for MSMARCO, where the dev split is used.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The benchmark aggregates datasets with existing annotations. For custom clustering datasets, cluster labels are generated using categories given to the papers by humans. Other datasets include annotations such as counterfactual detection, polarity classification, intents, emotions, duplicate questions, and human assessments of summaries.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Versioning at a dataset and software level is provided to reproduce results. The community is welcome to contribute task, dataset or metric contributions via pull requests to the MTEB codebase and additions to the leaderboard via an automatic submission format.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Toxic comments (Civil Comments platform), Amazon Alexa virtual assistant utterances.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Task imbalance: MTEB average scores are biased towards tasks with many datasets (retrieval, classification, clustering). Multilinguality: Retrieval and clustering are English-only. Data contamination: Overlap of MTEB datasets with model training datasets is ignored in MTEB scores.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 1. Long document datasets: Very long documents are missing. 2. Task imbalance: Summarization consists of only a single dataset. 3. Multilinguality: Retrieval and clustering are English-only; no code datasets. 4. Additional modalities: Focused solely on natural language applications.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking text embedding models, evaluating model performance on a variety of embedding tasks, selecting embedding models for industry applications.
